subject: reasoning
question:
Given below is a series of figures – A, B, C and D which follow a particular pattern. Which of the given option figures should come in place of E to continue the series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d7bf33f29aba7e6bb4c33c497bd2585675860e6503184182bdb6a88a9ca4f47.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Top-right symbol shifts in bottom-right corner position, bottom-right symbol shifts in bottom-left corner position and bottom-left symbol shifts in top-left corner position.

Top-left symbol shifts in top-right position but replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/071802e5665e33b03beb88f480f19159e9e9e14a61dbff2ea16af818afda6a89.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
